items.prompt: After strike, premium and spot have been recovered as integer cents, what arithmetic should the payoff fold use?

options.text: Float products and rounding after every option leg.
options.why: That reintroduces unnecessary approximate money operations.

options.text: Integer intrinsic values, signed quantities and sums.
options.why: The one-time bounded recovery removes float arithmetic from the subsequent money fold.

options.text: String concatenation for summing leg profits.
options.why: Concatenation does not add monetary values.

options.text: A new rounding of every contract count.
options.why: Quantity is already an integer contract input; no such rounding is required.

items.explanation: The one-time bounded recovery removes float arithmetic from the subsequent money fold.
